name: Asimov 1
price_note: DIY kit, delivered incl. shipping and tariffs; ~100 h assembly
summary: An open-source, 1.2 m DIY biped kit from Menlo Research. CAD and simulation files came out first in 2025, then a group-buy kit that began shipping in August 2026 at US$20,000 delivered. Menlo has since released a Python SDK and its locomotion-policy training code.
